t_advice_summary_textbox.text: certain colours proved better but the main advice was to do 'k' for 5 points which seemed better.  Still play around though as things change throughout the game

vb_textbox.text: This game is based on luck but i did follow basic rules and scored well.  Purple, yellow, orange and brown i found to be more successful but don't be afraid to pick the other colours and see how they compare.. you will figure it out too!
